Chef Marchetti’s Salmon

The best fish on the street, in the hardest kitchen on the street.

Read this aloud

Chef Marchetti carries a whole salmon past Sam at the front door and straight through to her kitchen like a trophy, wrapped in paper from the fish market. From the utility room comes a deep, slow woof, and then the claws of a very big dog on a tiled floor. The kitchen lights go on, and they stay on.

House Hard · Patience 7 · The prize whole salmon (Medium, portions: 1 per cat + 2) · Gone at the start of round 9 · Den Study

Who lives here Chef Marchetti, Sam, Brutus, The robot vacuum

For four cats. With three: Patience 8, gone at the start of round 12, Lights Out at the end of round 14, 3 Cattitude each. With five: Patience 6. The Robbery Tracker does this for you.

Chef Marchetti cooks for a living, and she hardly ever leaves her kitchen while there’s a fish on the island. Her partner Sam wanders the house. Their dog Brutus is enormous and not the least bit soft. Upstairs there’s a balcony door up the tree, a skylight propped open, a bedroom and a study.

How it plays

  • Chef Marchetti is busy: no noise will lure her out of the kitchen. She has Attention 2. You will have to work under her nose — or distract her, which gets harder every time.
  • Brutus can’t be befriended. Drive him off (rating 3: bring your Muscle) or stay out of his way.
  • Brutus’s dog door is a heavy flap: every cat through it makes a noise, right in his room. The way in from upstairs is long but quiet.
  • The fish is a lot of portions, and every one is a roll under the Chef’s nose. Carrying it out past Brutus is fewer rolls, but a carrier can’t hide and every haul can fail; most gangs do better eating it. This house keeps more cats than any other: keep the dog door open for the Chonky ones (the skylight is Tight).

The Prize Clock

WhenThe prize
Start of round 1Chef Marchetti puts it in the kitchen and stays there this round. Step 1: Sneaky or Savage, Tricky; then step 2: Streetwise or Savage, Tricky.
Start of round 9Gone — if the gang isn't holding it.
End of round 11Lights Out: any cat still inside is pinched.

The rooms

RoomTemptsNotes
Hall—Front door (behind Sam): big, Sneaky, Hard; or Sweet, round 1 only
KitchenFoodie, Knocker, Hunterdoor to the utility room (Streetwise or Savage, Hard)
Living roomLap Cat, Box Sitter—
Utility roomFoodiedoor to the kitchen (Streetwise or Savage, Hard); Brutus's dog door (a heavy flap): normal, no roll, noisy
Landing—Skylight, propped open: tight, a climb (Small things only), Sneaky or Savage, Tricky
BedroomBox SitterBalcony door (up the tree): normal, a climb (Small things only), Sneaky or Savage, Hard
StudyClimber, Curiousthe Den

Ways: Hall–Kitchen (big), Hall–Living room (big), Kitchen–Utility room (big), Hall–Landing (normal), Landing–Bedroom (big), Landing–Study (big).

Brutus’s dog door leads into the utility room, which is Brutus’s room. The skylight is Tight and a climb. The balcony door is Hard, up the tree.

Who lives here

Chef Marchetti (Grown-up)

Attention 2 · starts in the kitchen. Routine (d6): 1–5 Kitchen; 6 Hall.

Busy: too busy to answer noise; still sees everything in the room.

Sam (Grown-up)

Attention 1 · starts in the hall. Routine (d6): 1–2 stays put; 3–4 Living room; 5 Kitchen; 6 Study.

Brutus (Dog)

Rating 3 · starts in the utility room. Routine (d6): 1 stays put; 2 Kitchen; 3 Hall; 4 Living room; 5–6 sniffs one room toward the nearest free cat inside. Not soft: Sweet won't work on it.

The robot vacuum (Robot vacuum)

Starts in the living room; wanders Living room, Hall, Kitchen. Tempts Hunters; can be ridden.

The getaway

  1. The restaurant yard — Sneaky or Savage.
  2. The fishmonger's cat — Savage or Sneaky or Sweet; rating 2 (it takes 2 dice off).
  3. The market wall — Savage or Sneaky, Tricky.
  4. The market street — Streetwise or Savage, Tricky.

Then the hideout. The loot is its portions — whatever wasn't eaten inside.

Running Chef Marchetti's Salmon in Foundry

  1. Open the Robbery Tracker (the cat button on the token controls) and choose Start a robbery: pick this house and the gang. Every cat starts outside, with its starting Cattitude.
  2. Begin round runs the Prize Clock and, if anyone can be tempted, whispers you one-click Tempt buttons.
  3. Players move and act from the tracker (or roll from their cat sheets). The roll dialog fills in the Knack, help, Difficulty, the pet and who is watching; the card offers Push and Accept, and you can flip Seen.
  4. End round rolls the house's turn in the open: pets, noise, routines and Searching, holders, then Finding it.
  5. The house part ends at Lights Out, or at the end of a round when no free cat is left inside and the prize is out, eaten or gone (or when you press End the robbery because the gang runs for it). Any cat still inside is pinched.
  6. The getaway follows in the same tracker: the loot is shared out, each cat rolls over the next obstacle (help a friend and go over together; a Flop drops loot), and End the getaway round brings the warden on and corners the stragglers, who dodge or go in the van. When everyone is home or pinched, the loot is counted and the outcome is posted.

Every automation can be switched off in the system settings. The residents of this house are in the Residents compendium; the tracker works without them.
